messages:
Chris: Morning team — quick exec weekly. Two-line TL;DR: Private GA on track, tightening SLA targets, and a recent cache incident to close out. High-level asks below. :rocket:

Leila: noted. Can you paste the specific SLA percentile/interval you want?

Chris: aiming for 99.95% availability for Dedicated GA (monthly window); SLO alerting on 5m rollups. Also want p95 latency SLOs per route.

Sam: product update: launch plan drafted, canary cohorts + feature flags included. Plan is 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h if metrics stable. Need rollback hooks defined.

Ravi: quick incident summary (cache corruption, 04/02): root cause looks like a KV cache eviction race when mixed quantized kernels hit a specific size boundary. Impact: short spike in 500s for inference path, primarily Dedicated queues. Draft postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/pm/41345-cache-evict (WIP). Proposed fix: add KV lock + integrity check in runtime, and a short-term mitigation to throttle specific kernels. ETA for patch + canary: ~36h.

Leila: will take ownership of the runtime patch canary. I'll also add integrity checks and update the runbook. Scheduling a 30m sync with Ravi in 30m.

Sam: will add explicit rollback triggers: if canary p50 latency > baseline + 30% OR error rate > 0.5% for 10m then rollback. Also adding a manual cutoff for cost spikes. Snippet I'll add to the canary doc: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/rollout -d '{"canary":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`

ops-bot: deploy pipeline notification: canary job private-ga/canary-2026-05-10 started — 2/5 nodes healthy, health-checks running.

Chris: thanks — two exec asks: (1) Leila, confirm Console dashboards reflect the new SLA and token-cost units by EOD Friday; (2) Sam, publish the canary + rollback doc before the canary moves to 25%. If either hits a blocker, escalate to me and I'll join the war-room. :thumbsup:

Maya: heads-up from sales: major enterprise prospect asked about per-tenant noise/isolation guarantees for Dedicated. They want written wording on isolation + SLA. Recommending we pull a short enterprise FAQ for GA.

Chris: good catch. Sam/Leila — please prioritize a one-pager for sales and legal. I'll add to Friday exec agenda and follow up on the postmortem link. Thanks all — short sync Friday 09:30 PT for final go/no-go.

Leila: ack.

Ravi: ack, posting postmortem draft in 1hr.

Sam: ack, will publish doc and FAQ draft today.

Chris: end of thread.
